sources.text: The operator reconciles Widget custom resources and deploys a controller and admission webhook. Prow jobs run unit, integration, and kind-based E2E suites. The artifact collector stores controller logs and resource dumps.

architecture.text: The Widget controller reconciles Widget resources after its admission webhook becomes ready.

diagnostic_lifecycle.text: Webhook readiness precedes Widget creation, controller reconciliation, and E2E assertions.

test_flavors.text: Presubmits run unit and kind E2E jobs; periodic jobs run upgrade coverage.

artifacts.purpose: Shows reconciliation errors and webhook startup state.

failure_patterns.name: Webhook readiness failure
failure_patterns.signal: Tests report connection refused for the admission webhook
required_evidence: webhook Deployment and certificate resource dumps
failure_patterns.do_not_conclude: Do not infer a Widget reconciliation defect before webhook readiness is established.
failure_patterns.remediation_limit: Change webhook startup or certificate configuration only when captured logs or resources prove it.

transient_rules.only_if: A later discovery call succeeds and the test continues during the same run.
transient_rules.not_transient_if: Discovery never succeeds or the API service remains unavailable through failure.

triage_order.text: Read the failing JUnit case, then build-log, webhook resources, manager.log, and a passing job of the same flavor.

unresolved: Confirm the exact upgrade-job resource dump directory.
